text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry for the sudden intrusion! Um... 
Do you have a moment to spare?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"After what happened at the aquarium the 
other day, we started talking about all 
sorts of things... And Meek told me this:"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win together with Trainer." "I 
want to do my best in everything I can for 
that."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that's why she made the 
suggestion... Isn't that right, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...The two of you are role models. ...For 
me, and for Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...And we are also rivals. ...I'm sure we 
can push each other to greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...If we compete against each other, we'll 
get stronger. ...I'm sure of it, even 
more, much more.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to become stronger. ...So, I 
want to challenge you. Occasionally."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek...! U-Um! I'm asking you as well, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Competing with everything on the line 
would be great for both of you to gauge 
your skills and areas to work on...!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If it wouldn't be an imposition, I would 
love to propose a friendly contest like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Trainer Kiryuin said, fierce 
competition should provide great 
stimulation for <chrname> as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! You did it, Meek...!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. ...I'll give it my 
all.
